title: ChatGPT now answers with buttons, charts and mini apps
ticker: OpenAI rolls GPT-6 out to all ChatGPT users
Pwn2Own hackers break OpenAI Codex, LiteLLM
Google Cloud debuts a universal Gemini agent

scenes.narration: Did you know ChatGPT can now answer you with buttons, charts, and little apps it builds on the spot? It's called Intelligent UI, and it arrived with GPT-6.
This week, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 in ChatGPT worldwide. Paying users got it first, on a model called Sol. A day later, free users got it on a lighter model, Luna.
scenes.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI to every ChatGPT tier

scenes.narration: So what is Intelligent UI? UI means user interface: the buttons and screens you tap. Now the AI designs the screen for your answer, not just the words.
scenes.definition: The AI designs the screen for your answer, not just the words.

scenes.narration: Ask it to split a dinner bill. Before, you got a paragraph of math. Now you get a tiny bill splitter you can tap. Simple questions get text.
How does it work? You ask. The model decides the layout, then picks ready-made building blocks. A compiler turns them into a live screen while the answer streams in.
scenes.note: Parts appear before the answer is finished.

scenes.narration: Quick pause. Rather tap an answer than read one? Hit like, and share this with the friend who always splits the bill.
scenes.line: Like it. Share it with your bill-splitting friend.
scenes.sub: A new AI story every morning.

scenes.narration: It's quicker, too. OpenAI says on web search questions, the Instant version starts answering forty-four percent sooner, because it can reply while still thinking.
scenes.label: Sooner to start answering
scenes.sub: Web search questions, GPT-6 Instant vs the previous version. OpenAI's own test.

scenes.narration: Why does it matter? Chatbots are becoming app builders, and calculator websites get a new rival. But a pretty chart can still be wrong, so check where the numbers came from.
points: Calculator sites get a new rival

scenes.narration: Three takeaways. One: GPT-6 is rolling out to everyone in ChatGPT. Two: answers can be buttons, charts, and mini apps. Three: a smarter look doesn't mean smarter facts.
points: GPT-6 is rolling out to all ChatGPT users

scenes.narration: I checked this against OpenAI's announcement, MacRumors, and Search Engine Journal. Follow FredsDesk for a new AI story every morning.

post.description: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to every ChatGPT user, with Intelligent UI: answers that come as buttons, charts, forms and small tools built on the spot. Here's how it works and why you should still check the numbers.
